class.name: GodotDoctorSettings
class.brief_description: A resource that holds settings for the [GodotDoctorPlugin]. Used by [GodotDoctorPlugin] to store and access user preferences.

method.name: _has_validation_suites
method.description: Returns whether any non-null validation suites are assigned to [member validation_suites].

method.name: _validate_property
method.description: Editor callback that validates property values and updates their usage flags. This is used to disable the [member export_xml_report], [member xml_report_filename], and [member xml_report_output_dir] properties when they are not applicable based on the current settings.

members.member: The default position of the GodotDoctor dock in the editor.
Whether to automatically check for plugin updates on plugin startup.
Whether to automatically run validations when saving a script. If this is set to [code]false[/code], users will need to manually trigger validations.
Whether to show the welcome dialog when enabling the plugin.
Whether to show debug prints in the output console.
Whether to show toast notifications for important events.
Whether to show a severity glyph (info, warning, error) in the dock title.
Whether to treat warnings as errors in validation results. (Has no effect on the CLI; see [member GodotDoctorValidationSuite.treat_warnings_as_errors] instead).
Use default validations on [code]@export[/code] variables (instance validity and non-empty strings).
A list of scripts that should be ignored by Godot Doctor's default validations.
The validation suites that should be run when executing the CLI.

Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for the editor to signal readiness before starting the CLI runner anyway. This is a temporary workaround which is required because there currently is no surefire way to detect when the editor is ready. Recommended is to leave this on the default value, but it can be increased depending on your running environment. Set to [code]0[/code] to disable.

Maximum time (in seconds) to allow the CLI runner to execute before force-quitting with exit code [code]1[/code]. This prevents the process from hanging indefinitely if validation gets stuck. Set to [code]0[/code] to disable.
Whether to export a JUnit-style XML report after CLI validation completes.
The output filename used for the XML report.
The directory where the XML report is written.
